subject: Priyanka Rao — timebox request & equity/relocation ask
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick approval: Priyanka - counter offer and timebox

Team —

Priyanka Rao (candidate for Sr. ML Platform Engineer, req 129) just surfaced a competing offer. She sent the competing terms late last night: $315k base (US-West), 12k RSU rev spread over 4 years, and a $25k sign-on; Horizon's base is slightly higher than our band midpoint. She has asked for a firm decision by EOD Fri (10/6).

Recap of what we already offered (attached comp_matrix_priyanka_v3.xlsx): $290k base, 10k RSU (4y), relocation support up to $10k, standard benefits.

Her asks now: +$20–25k base (to $310–315k), +2k RSU, or $30k sign-on in lieu of base; expedited start date & a bump to relocation if she needs in-person ramp.

I need to know quickly: can we approve a targeted uplift (combination of sign-on + modest base uplift) within band tolerance, or do we need to escalate to Exec comp? Finance headcount/comp is the gating piece — headcount is available but band uplift requires approval.

Options I’d support:
- Offer A (preferred): $305k base + $15k sign-on + 11k RSU, start flexibility, keep relocation $10k.
- Offer B (if we can stretch): $315k base + 10k RSU + no sign-on (requires exec sign).

Please reply with approvals/concerns. If you're okay, I’ll present Offer A to Priyanka with a 72-hour sign window (or sooner if she presses).

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick approval: Priyanka - counter offer and timebox

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the comp matrix. Finance confirms we have headcount for req 129; band midpoint for Sr. ML Platform is $295k, upper band $320k. We generally avoid touching base above midpoint without a documented comp exception, but sign-on is a flexible lever.

I can approve Offer A (305k + 15k sign-on + 11k RSU) as a one-time comp exception for retention on this hire. Condition: include a 12-month clawback for sign-on if she leaves within 12 months and note the equity schedule at standard cadence.

If you want Offer B (315k), I need a quick note summarizing the org impact for Exec (headcount utilization, expected ramp timeline) — I can submit for urgent approval but can't guarantee same-day.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People & Finance (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick approval: Priyanka - counter offer and timebox

Jordan & Laura —

I agree with approving Offer A. We should also consider improving the start-date flexibility (remote first, office after 90 days) and confirming relocation cover if she needs same. Small procedural ask: have recruiting update the offer doc with the clawback language and send via DocuSign.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood offer update — timeline-sensitive

Hi Priyanka —

Thanks again for your time last week — enjoyed our deep dive on model infra. Quick update: we can move to Offer A to match the spirit of your ask. Final offer we’re proposing: $305,000 base, $15,000 sign-on (paid in two installments over 6 months), 11,000 RSUs vesting on our standard 4y schedule, relocation assistance up to $10,000, and remote-start flexibility. Attached is an outline (offer-outline-v2.pdf).

I want to be transparent: this is an approved comp exception. We can hold the offer open for 72 hours from today (until 10/6 09:00 PT). If you need a shorter window because of the competing offer, tell me and I’ll push to accelerate.

If this reads well, Marissa will send the formal DocuSign.

Best,
Jordan
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: offer-outline-v2.pdf (outline of compensation, standard benefits summary)
From: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@gmail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@horizonai.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood offer update — timeline-sensitive

Hi Jordan —

Thank you — I appreciate the swift response and the revised terms. A couple of questions before I sign:

1) Is there any flexibility to move 2k RSUs from time-based to a 1-year cliff (performance-based) or to increase equity to 12k total? Equity is a key part of my decision.
2) My competing offer requires an answer by 10/5 EOD (they asked for 48 hours after their final email). Could you extend the offer window to that deadline (10/5 EOD PT)?
3) I’m likely to request an earlier relocation reimbursement (I may need movers before my start) — can part of the sign-on be advanced to cover moving expenses?

I want to be upfront that compensation is important, but culture and technical work at Redwood are very attractive. Hoping we can find a quick middle ground.

Thanks —
Priyanka
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@gmail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood offer update — timeline-sensitive

Priyanka —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers:

1) Equity: we can increase RSUs to 12k (approved) — we’ll keep standard vesting (25% cliff at 1 year, then monthly). No performance-cliff for 2k; compensation team prefers time-based to keep admin overhead low.
2) Timebox: we’ll extend to 10/5 EOD PT to match your competing offer window.
3) Sign-on / relocation: we can front-load $10k of the sign-on as a moving advance (payable within first 30 days), remaining $5k per original schedule — clawback still applies if you leave within 12 months.

Marissa — can you issue the DocuSign with those tweaks (12k RSU, sign-on advance item, relocation note) and include the 12-month clawback clause? Laura — thanks again for the quick exception approval.

Priyanka — we’re excited about you joining; I’ll have the formal offer out within 4 business hours.

Jordan
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
